name: sentry
description: Official marketplace for the Sentry project's Claude Code plugin — a deterministic prompt-injection and agent-manipulation pattern detector.

plugins.name: sentry-scan
plugins.description: Scans text, files, or repos for prompt-injection and agent-manipulation patterns (agent-directed address, hidden-channel instructions, scope-expansion phrasing, confirmation-bypass claims, env/network exfil) by running Sentry's real deterministic regex engine.
